requirements.procedure: On changed user/admin journeys, use a screen reader and keyboard to inspect headings, field labels, validation announcements and dialog transitions. Record browser, assistive technology, route, locale, build and findings. axe passing is not a substitute.

requirements.statement: Evaluate real-user INP, LCP and CLS separately from laboratory scores.
requirements.procedure: Evaluate comparable real-user LCP, CLS and INP at p75 by release, device and route with sufficient sample counts. The private client now uses official web-vitals full-lifetime reporting; retain the latest value per metricId and distinguish bfcache visits. Public-page and admin field coverage must be established separately. Check delivery loss and first-party collection policy. Laboratory Lighthouse/TBT, mocked interactions and transport options do not establish field INP or delivery success.

requirements.statement: Verify operating-system text scaling and browser zoom on representative flows.
requirements.procedure: Test 200% browser zoom plus OS enlarged text on supported desktop/mobile browsers. Check clipped text, hidden controls, overlays and scrolling. Browser viewport resizing alone does not establish this behavior.

requirements.statement: Verify that reduced-motion preference removes nonessential motion.
requirements.procedure: Compare no-preference and reduce on routes with animations, scrolling and dialogs. Inspect actual motion and controls, not just the presence of a media query.

requirements.statement: Review modern form features and their fallbacks against supported browsers.
requirements.procedure: The automated public matrix runs Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; owned journeys cover selected authenticated client/admin states. Review browser/OS-specific permission denial, password-manager autofill, keyboard/IME, native dialogs, camera/media, actual system palettes, translations and private themes on supported devices. Axe author contrast is measured in normal colors because axe #3978 mixes system and authored colors; visually check real forced-color palettes. Record unsupported APIs and verify the existing fallback, rather than adding optional browser features solely to satisfy a recipe.

requirements.procedure: Inspect the actual camera/photo/voice and account deletion flows, permission denial and retry, privacy wording and third-party requests. Check collection purposes and retention with the owning product/backend policy. Automated masking only catches known patterns; a clean source audit does not establish privacy compliance. requirements.statement: Review deployed cookie/header policies and stage stricter CSP and Trusted Types against real integrations.
requirements.procedure: Inspect actual HTTPS cookie attributes, expiration, logout recovery and cross-tab ownership. Website/admin secrets use HttpOnly cookies; explicit Mini App access JWTs are memory-only. Verify that every static document has its build-owned script hash meta policy before scripts and that SSR sends a fresh nonce header and no-store. Edge compatibility headers combine with these policies. Real Nginx/Chromium enforcement tests do not certify deployed headers, provider/device flows, Trusted Types or a nonce-only strict-dynamic policy. Record deployed revision and Google/Telegram/Paddle, hydration and locale evidence; see docs/frontend/SCRIPT_CSP.md.
